title: 第8章气血关180公斤！
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
之前的王铁说一周之内能够入门，就算是悟性很不错的了，而林枫能够三天入门，说明了此子的悟性也极其高。

    在配合那上中的根骨，怕是未来八品武者必有此人的一席之地。

    不过陈安也不是那些小孩子了，六十年来的磨练，早就让陈安的心性变得极其的稳重。

    “武道，争得不是现在，而是……滔滔不绝！”

    陈安内心微微呢喃了一声，旋即打好饭，返回了自己的小木屋。

    ……

    时间，流逝到了第五日。

    子时。

    系统冰冷的声音在陈安的脑海之中响起。

    【叮，每日天赋点发放成功！】

    【天赋点+1】

    “加点，悟性！”

    【叮，加点成功！】

    陈安立刻调出面板。

    【悟性：15】

    【评价：哟，文秀才来了！】

    他缓缓闭上了双眼，没有急着起身修炼，而是再次在脑海中，回溯王铁今日的演练。

    所有的一切，都如同一幅被瞬间点亮的浩瀚星图，清晰无比地呈现在他的意识之中！

    整套《鲸吞功》从起手到收功的数百个细节，以及其内在的气血运转脉络，再无半分秘密可言。

    豁然开朗！

    他长身而起，动作间再无丝毫迟疑。

    双脚开立，沉腰立马，一个标准的《鲸吞功》起手式——鲸吞万里，被他行云流水般地摆了出来。

    “呼……”

    一口悠长的气息被他缓缓吸入。

    刹那间，他体内那股早已壮大如麻绳的气血，瞬间被引动。

    这股在修炼《太极桩》时温顺平和的力量，此刻仿佛被注入了截然不同的灵魂，一头沉睡的深海巨兽，在此刻苏醒！

    轰！

    气血不再是之前那般无序地冲撞，而是在他强大意念的引导下，沿着《鲸吞功》那条霸道绝伦的经脉路线，开始了第一次正式的奔行！

    一股狂暴的能量，瞬间流遍四肢百骸！
content_en:
Wang Tie previously said that he had a very good understanding if he could get started within a week, but Lin Feng could get started in three days, which shows that his understanding is extremely high.

    Coupled with that superior talent, I am afraid that there will be a place for this person among eighth-level warriors in the future.

    But Chen An is no longer one of those children. Sixty years of training have long made Chen An's temperament extremely stable.

    "Martial arts, the fight is not now, but... endlessly!"

    Chen An murmured slightly in his heart, immediately packed his meal and returned to his cabin.

    …

    Time passed by on the fifth day.

    Zishi.

    The cold voice of the system sounded in Chen An's mind.

    [Ding, daily talent points are distributed successfully! 】

    [Talent point +1]

    "Add more points, understanding!"

    [Ding, the extra points are successful! 】

    Chen An immediately called up the panel.

    【Comprehension: 15】

    [Evaluation: Oh, Wen Xiucai is here! 】

    He slowly closed his eyes and did not rush to get up to practice. Instead, he reviewed Wang Tie's today's drill in his mind again.

    Everything was like a vast star map that was instantly lit up, clearly presented in his consciousness!

    The entire "Whale Swallowing Technique" contains hundreds of details from the start to the end, as well as the inner circulation of Qi and blood. There is no secret at all.

    suddenly see the light!

    He stood up, without any hesitation in his movements.

    He stood up with his feet spread wide, lowered his waist and stood upright. He performed the standard starting position of "Whale Swallowing Kung Fu" - Swallowing Whales Ten Thousand Miles, smoothly.

    "Huh..."

    A long breath was slowly inhaled by him.

    In an instant, the energy and blood in his body that had grown as strong as a hemp rope was instantly activated.

    This gentle and peaceful force when practicing "Tai Chi Zhuang" seems to be injected with a completely different soul at this moment. A sleeping deep sea beast wakes up at this moment!

    boom!

    Qi and blood no longer collided in disorder as before, but under the guidance of his powerful thoughts, along the overbearing meridian route of "Whale Swallowing Kung Fu", began its first official run!

    A violent energy instantly flowed through the limbs and bones!
title_en: Chapter 8 The energy and blood barrier is 180 kilograms!
